# A player who swore revenge on a raider is reminded of it, now and then.
eir_revenge_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		has_variable = eir_revenge_target
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 25
		1 = eir.1226
	}
